records.title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I (SAFFIRE-I)

objective.text: The investigation measured large-scale fire growth in low gravity and examined low-gravity flammability limits against NASA normal-gravity material-flammability screening.

approach.text: The experiment ran in an instrumented flow duct inside the Cygnus resupply vehicle after it departed the ISS. The tested fabric, Sibal, comprised cotton on a fiberglass substrate (75% cotton and 25% fiberglass by weight). Fans drove airflow through the duct at 20 cm/s. Two cameras recorded flame images; thermocouples, radiometers, solid-state gas/pressure sensors and anemometers measured thermal, radiative, pressure, gas-composition and flow quantities.
